item.title: Number of cold-stunned turtles in treatment swells to over 450
item.description: BOSTON/CAPE COD – The New England Aquarium has announced that it has treated over 450 live sea turtles during the 2025 stranding season, with new patients arriving daily. item.title: Vehicle overturns in Bourne
item.description: BOURNE – A vehicle overturned in Bourne shortly before 8 AM Saturday. The crash happened on the ramp from the Scenic Highway to Route 3. The driver was able to self-extricate and appeared to have escaped injury. The cause of the crash is under investigation. The post Vehicle overturns in Bourne appeared first on CapeCod.com.

item.title: Two people taken to hospital after traffic crash in Hyannis
item.description: HYANNIS – Two people were transported to Cape Cod Hospital after a traffic crash in Hyannis.
